text: The college has a first-aid center with a trained nurse available during working hours (9 AM - 5 PM). Basic medicines, first-aid supplies, and a stretcher are available. For emergencies, the college has tie-ups with nearby hospitals including Avadi Government Hospital and private hospitals. An ambulance facility is available for emergencies.

Regular health checkups are conducted for all students at the beginning of each academic year. The college organizes blood donation camps, health awareness programs, and yoga/meditation sessions. Group medical insurance is available for students at subsidized rates through the college. Mental health counseling services are provided by trained counselors.

Safety measures include: 24/7 CCTV surveillance across the campus including entrances, corridors, labs, and parking areas. Security guards are posted at all entry/exit points with visitor registration. Fire safety equipment (extinguishers, alarms, sprinklers) is installed in all buildings. Regular fire drills and safety awareness programs are conducted. Anti-ragging committee actively monitors and ensures a ragging-free campus.
